diagnosis: The user needs to rotate a possibly compromised API token. Provide guidance on creating a new scoped key and revoking the old one per the unified auth model. No internal escalation needed.
reply:
I’m sorry to hear about the token leak. Because your account uses Unified Auth, you can generate a new scoped API key, switch your integration to use the new key, and then revoke the compromised key. The revocation takes effect immediately, so once you’ve confirmed the new key is working, you can safely disable the old one. You can follow the step‑by‑step instructions in our knowledge‑base article on scoped API keys.

If you run into any issues while creating or revoking keys, please let us know and we’ll help you troubleshoot.
